payload.description_html: Specimen referred to Jabalisaurus tethyensis (originally identified as Aegirosaurus sp.) (JME-SOS-08369) from Eichstätt-Blumenberg, Germany. (A) in normal light. (B) composite picture in UV light indicating position of pictures in Fig. 7. (C) interpretative drawing. L, left; R, right. Type I and II soft tissue marked. Scale bar = 20 cm.
